title: Hindi classics
intro: Well-known Hindi books from the sixteenth century to today, across epic poetry, novels, plays, verse and stories.

items.title: Padmavat
items.creator: Malik Muhammad Jayasi
items.note: Epic poem in Awadhi on Queen Padmavati and Alauddin Khalji

items.title: Sursagar
items.creator: Surdas
items.note: Braj verses on the childhood of Krishna

items.title: Ramcharitmanas
items.creator: Tulsidas
items.note: Awadhi retelling of the Ramayana in verse

items.title: Bihari Satsai
items.creator: Bihari Lal
items.note: Seven hundred couplets in Braj on love and devotion

items.title: Andher Nagari
items.creator: Bharatendu Harishchandra
items.note: Satirical play about a kingdom without judgement

items.title: Pariksha Guru
items.creator: Lala Srinivas Das
items.note: Often named the first Hindi novel, on a merchant's son

items.title: Chandrakanta
items.creator: Devaki Nandan Khatri
items.note: Fantasy romance of two royal lovers and a magical fort

items.title: Sevasadan
items.creator: Premchand
items.note: Novel about a woman pushed into prostitution

items.title: Rangbhoomi
items.creator: Premchand

items.title: Nirmala

items.title: Madhushala

items.title: Godan
items.creator: Premchand

items.title: Kamayani
items.creator: Jaishankar Prasad

items.title: Shekhar: Ek Jivani

items.title: Banbhatt ki Aatmakatha
